items.information:
Welcome to Alexandria Spring 2026! This competition takes place in Friday the 10th of April, with many side events and some NxNs.
Please go through the **Events, Schedule, First-time competitors, and Volunteers** tabs carefully to ensure you know what to expect.

items.name: Nebraska Championship 2026
items.information:
While only residents of Nebraska are eligible for the title of Nebraska State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Nebraska Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NebraskaChampionship2026#71306-nebraska-champion-titles) tab.

#Please check the HOTELS tab before registering as hotel options in Falls City are limited.  We give several options for surrounding cities.

items.name: NZ South Island Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzOTU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8f4713f4a47fff3cbbc6d7d1387d90bd332ff74b/1000031281.png)

NZ South Island Championship 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. 

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
